title: covering-min-modulus
description:
This repository re-checks the record covering system with minimum modulus 42, from Tyler Owens's 2014 master's thesis, and searches for a system with minimum modulus 43.

Status: not started. No independent check or new system from this project is present yet.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
